segments.summary: Goal update, code insertion, and memory controls have strong generic wiring and accessibility evidence, but destructive and durable memory semantics remain materially underspecified.
Memory maintenance controls are wired and accessibility-testable, while maintenance job lifecycle/recovery and the auto-save-unverified privacy preference are not behaviorally closed.
Chat configuration controls have consistent dispatcher and accessibility contracts, but debug/context disclosure authority and durable mutation/conflict semantics are missing.
Operational controls are generically wired and accessibility-testable, but user-command execution lacks a security boundary and retry/history mutations lack safe state machines.
Chat send has a canonical event oracle and all controls have accessibility evidence, while web operations and send/stop failure, trust, and concurrency semantics remain open.
